test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

I wish I **am taller.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the verb "am" in the clause "I wish I am taller," which is incorrect in the subjunctive mood.
 
• In hypothetical or wishful statements, the verb "were" is used instead of "was" or "am," regardless of the subject.
 
• The correct sentence should be "I wish I were taller," which expresses a hypothetical desire.
 
• Option 1, "were taller," correctly applies the subjunctive mood.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I wish I were taller."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "was taller"** – This is incorrect because "was" is not used in the subjunctive mood for hypothetical statements.
 
• **Option 3: "would be taller"** – This is incorrect because it changes the meaning of the sentence to a conditional statement rather than a hypothetical wish.
 
• **Option 4: "could be taller"** – This is incorrect as it implies ability or possibility rather than expressing a wish.
